messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Not able to publish my app on shiny cloud ,its gives error while connecting to my postgresql data base
parts:
Hi,

I suspect the issue is that your database is not accessible to the shinyapps.io servers. If the database is hosted inside a corporate or campus network, you will likely need to contact your network administrators so your firewall can be configured to allow access from shinyapps.io servers.

The ip addresses for shinyapps.io servers, can be found here.

-Andy
